title: Gleitring-Systeme cuts the allocation for Cartridge seal HI 45 mm, ATEX, drinking-water approved
briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gleitring-Systeme Kaltenbrunn AG. Gleitring-Systeme cuts the allocation for Cartridge seal HI 45 mm, ATEX, drinking-water approved. Need: 1810 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 67 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 90. Prepare from the data package.
